snippet.description:
Are your UPSC Mains notes becoming too long and difficult to revise?

Santosh Sir explains why your Mains notes should ideally be prepared in a question-answer format. Instead of collecting every possible fact, dimension and point, your notes should help you answer the questions that UPSC is actually likely to ask.

A question-answer approach helps you:

Cover every UPSC Mains syllabus bullet point
Think in terms of possible Mains questions
Build introductions, dimensions and conclusions around questions
Keep your notes concise and revision-friendly
Avoid unnecessarily studying and collecting excessive content

The goal is not to have 25 different dimensions for every topic. The goal is to have enough relevant content to write a strong answer within the given word limit.

For UPSC Mains, your notes should help you write answers—not just collect information.
